<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395. This matches the [M + Na]⁺ adduct of a neutral molecule with a monoisotopic mass of ≈212.150 Da. The formula C₁₆H₂₀ (exact mass 212.1565 Da) fits this mass within a few millidaltons, which is the best match among plausible C/H/O combinations. No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required to explain the observed mass, so the molecular formula is C₁₆H₂₀. 

The required format is “CxHyOzX”. With no oxygen or other heteroatoms, we can write O₀ and omit the extra element X. Hence the answer is:

C16H20O0</thought>
<final_answer>C16H20O0</final_answer>
